collection.title: VW California T6.1 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW California T6 2019 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this California, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
